text: Ships burn and sink off Odo Island, the fishing fails, and an elder names [an ancient creature from the sea|origin|old beliefs and legends]. The paleontologist Yamane finds giant radioactive footprints and judges the beast [stirred by hydrogen bomb tests|wrong|meddling with life itself]. When it wades out of Tokyo Bay and [burns through the city|who_suffers|whole communities] with atomic breath, [shrugging off depth charges, tanks and jets|rules|nothing can stop it], his daughter Emiko must decide whether to reveal Serizawa's secret weapon, the Oxygen Destroyer.
